title: Online Preference Weight Estimation Algorithm with Vanishing Regret for Car-Hailing in Road Network

problem.claim: Route planning efficiency is important for car-hailing services.

gap.claim: Existing road-weight assignment techniques often focus on travel time and road length but cannot incorporate passenger preferences.

narrative_sequence.summary: Car-hailing service-provider utilities depend substantially on route-planning efficiency.
A common route-planning framework assigns weights to roads and computes shortest paths.
Existing weight-assignment techniques emphasize travel time and road length while omitting passenger preferences.

unknowns: The abstract units do not state the proposed method or its algorithmic details.
The abstract units do not report experiments, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results.
The abstract units do not specify how passenger preferences are represented or incorporated.
